model_policy: pdn=ideal: direct ideal die POWER/GND references, no POWER/GND package R/L/C; vendor signal-pin R/L/C retained
acceptance: Unchanged: independent timestep and section refinements; all probes pass integrated RMS and both signed extrema on the union of native timestamps at 1% + 1 mV
runtime_context: Concurrent native cases and the local test suite overlapped; elapsed times are not controlled performance comparisons. Only exact-hash native extraction outputs were replayed; every idle and switching transient was freshly executed in ngspice. Level 3 isolation retains the full-board planned seeds and copper. Vendor assets are not redistributed.
